name: Chidinma Onyemachi
headline: Data Analyst
biography:
Hi, I’m Chidinma Onyemachi, a Data Analyst passionate about turning raw data into clear insights that support better decision-making.
I work with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, and ODK, using these tools to clean, analyze, visualize, and communicate data effectively. I also have an interest in Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL) and using data to understand performance and identify areas for improvement.
I enjoy going beyond simply creating reports. I like asking questions, finding patterns, validating results, and turning analysis into a story that people can understand and use.
I’m continuously building my skills, taking on new analytical challenges, and growing as a data professional.
My goal is simple: use data to make complex information clearer and decisions smarter.
